settings.downloadInReview.description: If you this setting is false, the download button won't be visible for reviewers file status is `In Review`.

settings.downloadNeedsChanges.description: If you this setting is false, the download button won't be visible for reviewers file has been marked as `Need Changes`.

settings.downloadApproved.description: If you this setting is false, the download button won't be visible for reviewers file has been approved.

settings.commentInReview.description: If you this is set as false, reviewers cannot create, edit or delete comments when the review status is `In review`.

settings.commentNeedsChanges.description: If you this is set as false, reviewers cannot create, edit or delete comments when the review status is `Needs Changes`

settings.commentApproved.description: If you this is set as false, reviewers cannot create, edit or delete comments when the file has been approved.

settings.emailNotifications.description: If you this setting is set as false, reviewers without a registered account will no longer receive email notifications for project activities (new comments, new files and versions, file status changes and submitted reviews).

settings.passwordProtection.description: When this setting is true, any new reviewers without a Filestage account will need to enter the password as specified in the `password` field

settings.uploadingEnabled.description: If this setting is set as `true`, external reviewers will be able to upload new files and new versions to this reviewer group.

settings.anonymousReviewers.description: If you this setting as `true`, all reviewers will be anonymous to each other.

settings.password.description: This field is required when `passwordProtection` is set as `true`. It creates a password to protect this reviewer group.

post.summary: Copy Comments Between Versions or Reviews
post.description: Copies comments between Filestage versions or reviews.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

reviewId.description: The unique identifier of the **target** review where the comments will be copied to.

sourceReviewId.description: The ID of the source review to copy the comments from.

copyAll.description: If `true`, all comments from the source are copied. If `false`, only the comments specified in the `commentIds` array are copied.

commentIds[].description: An array of specific comment IDs to copy from the source review. This is only used when `copyAll` is `false`.

isBetweenVersions.description: Determines the copy mode. If `true`, comments are copied from one version to another. If `false`, comments are copied from one review step to another.

keepAnnotationsAndMarker.description: If `true`, the comment's annotations and markers (positions on the file) are included in the copy. If `false`, only the comment text and metadata are copied.

fileId.description: The ID of the file that gets new version.

fileURL.description: A URL where the file can be downloaded. Our server will perform a GET request to this URL.

fileHeaders.description: A key-value map of HTTP headers to include in the GET request to the `fileURL`. You can use this to provide authentication tokens (e.g., `Authorization: Bearer <token>`) if the URL is protected or other headers neccessary to make the GET request to the `fileUrl` successful.

callbackURL.description: The URL where we will send a POST request to notify you of the upload's final status. This URL must be publicly accessible.

callbackHeaders.description: A key-value map of HTTP headers to include in the POST request to your `callbackURL`. Use this for security, such as including a pre-shared secret or auth token.

fileName.description: The desired name for the file, including its extension (e.g., `document.pdf`). If omitted, the name will be inferred.

uploaderEmail.description: The email address of the user you want to upload the file on behalf of. This user will be displayed as the file uploader.

sectionId.description: The ID of a specific section within a project to organize the file into. If omitted, the file is placed in the default section.

externalId.description: A custom identifier from your system to associate with the file, useful for cross-referencing. **Note:** We do not enforce uniqueness on this field; it is your responsibility to manage it.

externalMetadata.description: Custom data that could be associated with the File. `externalMetadata` field cannot exceed 10Kb of data size and also a maximum of 5 object properties are allowed in this object.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
